findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：Apple 歷來為 QCOM 最大客戶之一，但公司預期 Apple 今後將主要使用自家內部開發的 modem，而非 QCOM 產品。
findings.excerpt: For example, Apple has historically purchased our modem products for use in its devices and has historically been one of our largest customers, but we expect that Apple will primarily use its own internally developed modem products, rather than our products, in its devices going forward.

findings.claim: 10-K：部分最大客戶過去、現在及未來可能使用競爭對手晶片，且已開發或正開發自家積體電路產品（實質成為競爭者）；中國客戶亦有自研或改用競品。
findings.excerpt: Certain of our largest customers have in the past used, currently use and may in the future use our competitors’ integrated circuit products in some or all of their devices, rather than our products. Further, certain of those customers have developed, are developing or may develop their own integrated circuit products (effectively making them competitors)
